description: 2 opposing effective hinges for closed-open-closed folding.
units: metres, kilograms, seconds; Z-up in MJCF; radians for joint/control angles
controller: Bounded virtual actuators, scripted demonstration, not a learned policy.
limitations: Middle panel fixed to a virtual fixture. Effective single-axis hinge models; no internal cam simulation.
Display seams are render-only linear-blend skins in MuJoCo; the source GLB retains its original morph animation. No flexible-display material simulation.
The Overview film softens rear model lettering as a presentation effect; appearance.glb is the corresponding original source asset.
Physical dimensions, masses, friction and drive parameters are editable estimates. Collision checks concern simplified proxies.
MuJoCo viewer shading differs from the source GLB PBR and the lit Overview video.
